title: 第239章 雅俗对垒攀比饲魔第238章 甜腻生腐念僵成规
content_zh:
第二天天刚亮，甜泉边就支起了两座台子，隔着一个泉眼，遥遥对峙。
东边是墨长老带的“雅甜会”。台子铺着云锦，摆着玉案，案上糖糕全是用万年寒冰雕的模具蒸出来的，圆得像是拿圆规量过，糖霜厚薄均匀，连上面点缀的草叶纹都是用金箔贴的，在晨光里闪着冷光。几个穿锦缎的仙童站在台后，手里捧着玉盘，脸上挂着训练有素的微笑，半点甜意也无，倒像是庙里的泥塑菩萨。墨长老坐在主位，手里摇着玉骨折扇，慢条斯理地品着杯里的“仙露”，那露水清得没有一丝杂色，一看就寡淡得很。
西边是陈默搭的“歪糕摊”。没台子，就几块破木板钉的架子，架子上摆的东西五花八门：阿卯蒸的歪糖糕（这次没用模具，歪得各有特色）、灵圃仙仆捣的野薄荷泥（装在豁口的瓦罐里）、烈阳神将那颗成了化石的野果（直接搁在块青石上）、还有小仙童娘亲绣的歪荷包、老仙仆藏的半块麦芽糖……乱七八糟堆了一片，在雅甜会那整齐的玉案衬托下，显得格外扎眼。
陈默自己蹲在架子后面，正用柴刀削竹签，削好了就插在歪糖糕上，嘴里骂骂咧咧：“***，糕是给人吃的，不是给眼睛看的！圆了就能甜？老子砍柴劈了三十年，就没见过几根笔直的柴火，不照样烧得旺？”
云清瑶站在他旁边，没说话，只是把昨天那块拼好的碎糖糕放在最显眼的位置，又在旁边插了根野薄荷嫩茎。她今天依旧穿着素布裙，发髻上的野薄荷晃得欢实，在一片锦衣华服里，像棵长在玉石缝里的野草，倔强又鲜活。
“哼，粗陋不堪，也敢称‘摊’？”墨长老摇着折扇，声音不大，却刚好能让全场听见，“甜念者，当存雅意，合规制。似此等歪扭之物，只配称‘杂食’，岂能与我‘雅甜’相提并论？”他折扇一指，身后一个锦缎仙童立刻端起一盘玉雕糖糕，朗声道：“此乃‘如意糕’，取灵泉之水，以太上忘情经文火蒸制，圆融如意，合乎天道，甜中雅品！”
台下围观的凡脉后裔们面面相觑。他们大多捧着自家带来的歪念物，此刻被“雅甜”二字压得抬不起头，有人悄悄把手里的歪糖糕往身后藏，有人看着玉盘里的如意糕，眼里露出羡慕的神色。攀比的种子，就这么悄无声息地种下了。
“如意个屁！”陈默猛地站起来，柴刀往木架上一剁，震得那些歪糖糕都跳了一下，“老子问你，这糕是你娘蒸的？还是你媳妇做的？你蒸的时候烫着手没？吃的时候烫嘴没？圆得跟个球似的，连点人情味都没有，也好意思叫甜？”
他这一嗓子吼得实在，台下不少人脸一红，想起自家蒸糕时烫到的手、递糕时对方的笑，那些才是真东西。可墨长老还没开口，另一个穿绫罗的仙童就尖声道：“乡野村夫，懂什么雅致？你家那歪糕，能摆得上台面？能入得了神帝的眼？我家公子的如意糕，昨日已呈给公主品鉴，公主都赞了‘工整’二字！”
这话一出，气氛瞬间变了。原本只是“雅俗”之争，现在扯上了神帝和公主，还带上了“品鉴”，攀比的味道一下子浓得呛人。不少凡脉后裔看着自己手里“拿不出手”的念物，脸上露出了羞愧和不安，有人甚至想把东西偷偷扔了。
地脉深处，那粒黑种猛地颤了一下。顶端的眼睛睁开一条缝，瞳孔里倒映着台上台下的众生相——羡慕、羞愧、不安、虚荣……这些“异化念”像最上等的养料，顺着地脉往黑种体内涌。它的根须肉眼可见地粗壮了一圈，叶片上的反向纹路亮得发油，几乎要撑破地脉。
云清瑶冷眼看着这一切。她看见一个小仙童偷偷把娘亲绣的、有点脱线的荷包塞回怀里，转而羡慕地盯着玉盘里的金箔草叶；她看见灵圃仙仆的瓦罐被几个锦缎仙童嘲笑“粗鄙”，老脸涨得通红，却不敢反驳；她甚至看见烈阳神将捏紧了拳头，掌心的草叶印烫得吓人，却碍于“雅俗”之辩，不好发作——毕竟，对方抬出了“合乎天道”、“神帝品鉴”。
“工整？”云清瑶终于开口，声音不大，却像冰珠落玉盘，瞬间压住了所有嘈杂。她走到歪糕摊前，拿起那块拼好的碎糖糕，又指了指阿卯刚蒸好的一盘歪得各有特色的糖糕，“墨长老，你说这糕歪，不合规制。那本宫问你，何为‘规’？何为‘制’？”
墨长老折扇一顿，冷笑道：“规矩者，天道也。甜念节乃神帝钦定，自然要有章法，方能显我神域威仪，承太上忘情真谛。”
“太上忘情真谛？”云清瑶嘴角勾起一抹极淡的嘲讽，“太上忘情，是忘‘私念’，不是忘‘念’。甜念节祭的是凡俗生民之念，是阿卯记着奶奶的烫手糕，是灵圃仙仆念着娘亲的薄荷水，是烈阳神将三万年不忘的一口野果甜。这些念，有烫手的疼，有缺角的憾，有歪扭的真，这才是‘念’！你那如意糕，圆融无瑕，却无疼无憾，无情无念，与太上忘情何干？与甜念何干？”
她话锋一转，指尖指向雅甜会的玉案：“至于‘显神域威仪’？神域威仪，是靠几块冰雕玉砌的糕点撑起来的？还是靠万千凡脉后裔心头那点活生生的甜意撑起来的？”她猛地一挥袖，那盘金光闪闪的如意糕被一股柔力托起，飞到甜泉上空，“本宫今日便告诉你，何为真正的‘甜念’！”
她没动用仙力摧毁，只是屈指一弹，一粒从阿卯糖糕上掉下来的、带着牙印的糖渣，飞射而出，精准地击中了那块如意糕。
“噗——”
没有惊天动地的爆炸，那块被奉为“雅品”的如意糕，被那粒凡俗糖渣碰到的瞬间，就像被戳破的肥皂泡，连同下面的玉盘一起，无声无息地化为了齑粉，连点渣都没剩下。只有一丝极淡的、属于凡俗的甜香，在泉水上空散开。
全场死寂。

墨长老脸上的假笑瞬间僵住，折扇“咔嚓”一声捏得粉碎。他身后的锦缎仙童们更是面无人色，连呼吸都忘了。
陈默咧嘴笑了，露出一口白牙：“爽！老子就说嘛，真金不怕火炼，真甜不怕牙啃！你那破糕，连个牙印都经不住！”
就在这时，地脉深处传来一声沉闷的巨响，像是某种东西撑破了地壳。紧接着，甜泉中央的泉水猛地炸开，那株一直潜伏的黑草，终于破土而出！但它不再是纯粹的黑色，叶片上缠绕着灰黑色的邪气，顶端的眼睛已经长大了一倍，瞳孔里不再是虚无，而是倒映着刚才台下众人的羡慕、羞愧、攀比……那些“异化念”在它眼里流转，成了滋养它的养分。
“桀桀桀……”一阵令人牙酸的怪笑从黑草顶端传来，不再是之前的嘶吼，而是带着一种黏腻的、令人作呕的甜腻感，“多美的念啊……羡慕、羞愧、攀比……比单纯的怨气好吃多了！谢谢你们，帮我喂饱了自己！”
它狂笑着，根须猛地扎进甜泉地脉，原本清澈带着暖意的泉水，瞬间以肉眼可见的速度变得粘稠、暗淡，表面浮起一层油光光的腻质，散发出的不再是甜香，而是一种令人窒息的、甜得发腐的气息。
黑种，不，现在该叫它“腻魔”了。它借着“念的异化”，终于破土而出，第一次，主动展露在世人面前。
神帝的身影出现在九龙殿外的云台上，看着下方甜泉的异变，看着那株腻魔，看着台下瞬间陷入恐慌的凡脉后裔，混沌的眸子里第一次露出了清晰的痛色。他定下甜念节，本是想护住这点点凡俗星火，却不想，这星火还没燎原，就先被自己的“规制”和“攀比”，喂肥了潜伏的魔物。
“父帝……”云清瑶抬头看向云台，声音里带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖。她知道，真正的考验，才刚刚开始。这腻魔，吃的是念，吐的是腐，远比之前的黑草更难对付。
陈默把柴刀从木架上拔出来，刀身上的歪草叶纹在腐甜的空气中亮得发烫。他吐了口唾沫，咧嘴笑道：“妈的，出来就好！躲在地下偷吃算什么本事？出来，老子劈了你这满身馊味的狗东西！让大伙儿看看，到底是你的馊甜厉害，还是老子的歪糕够劲！”
腻魔的瞳孔缩了缩，盯着陈默刀身上的纹路，又扫过云清瑶指尖的断尺，最后落在那些被吓住却依旧攥着自家歪念物的凡脉后裔身上，嘴角裂开一个无声的、充满恶意的笑。
它不急。
现在，它已经尝到了“念”最美味的部分。
接下来，它要看着这些“念”，如何在它的腐甜中，互相倾轧，自我腐烂。
那才是盛宴。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
At dawn the next day, two platforms were set up beside the sweet spring, facing each other from a distance across the spring.
To the east is the "Ya Tian Club" led by Elder Mo. The table is covered with brocade, and there is a jade table. The sugar cakes on the table are all steamed with molds carved from thousands of years of ice. They are as round as if they were measured with a compass. The frosting is evenly thick, and even the grass patterns dotted on it are pasted with gold foil, shining coldly in the morning light. Several fairies in brocade stood behind the stage, holding jade plates in their hands, with well-trained smiles on their faces. They were not sweet at all, but looked like clay statues of Bodhisattvas in the temple. Elder Mo was sitting at the main seat, shaking the jade fracture fan in his hand, and slowly sipping the "immortal dew" in the cup. The dew was so clear that there was no trace of color, and it looked very bland at first glance.
To the west is the "crooked cake stall" set up by Chen Mo. There is no table, just a few broken boards nailed to the shelves. There are all kinds of things on the shelves: A Mao's steamed crooked sugar cakes (no molds were used this time, each crooked has its own characteristics), wild mint mud pounded by the immortal servants of Lingpu (packed in a cracked earthen jar), Lieyang God General The fossilized wild fruit (placed directly on a piece of bluestone), the crooked purse embroidered by the little fairy girl, and the half piece of maltose hidden by the old fairy servant... were piled up in a mess, which looked particularly eye-catching against the neat jade table of the Yatian Club.
Chen Mo himself squatted behind the shelf and was cutting bamboo sticks with a hatchet. After cutting them, he inserted them into the crooked sugar cake. He cursed in his mouth: "***, the cake is for people to eat, not for the eyes! If it is round, it will be sweet? I have been chopping firewood for thirty years, and I have never seen a few straight firewood. Isn't it still burning brightly?"
Yun Qingyao stood next to him without saying a word. She just placed the piece of crushed sugar cake that she had put together yesterday in the most conspicuous place, and inserted a young wild mint stem next to it. She was still wearing a plain cloth skirt today, and the wild mint on her bun was dazzling. She looked like a weed growing in the cracks of jade in the brocade clothes, stubborn and fresh.
"Hmph, how dare you call it a 'stall' when it's so crude?" Elder Mo shook his folding fan. His voice was not loud, but just enough to be heard by the whole audience. "Those who think sweetly should keep their elegance and comply with the regulations. Such crooked things are only worthy of being called 'omnivorous'. How can they be called 'elegant and sweet' with me?" Comparable?" He folded his fan and pointed, and a brocade fairy boy behind him immediately picked up a plate of jade-carved sugar cakes and said loudly: "This is the 'Ruyi Cake', which is made from water from the Lingquan and steamed with the ethereal scriptures. It is perfect and harmonious, in line with the way of heaven, and sweet and elegant!"
The descendants of Mortal Lineage who were watching in the audience looked at each other in astonishment. Most of them were holding crooked things brought by themselves, and at this moment they were so overwhelmed by the word "elegant and sweet" that they could not lift their heads. Some quietly hid the crooked sugar cakes behind their backs, while some looked at the wishful cakes on the jade plate with envy in their eyes. The seeds of comparison were so quietly planted.
"What a bastard!" Chen Mo suddenly stood up and slashed the wooden stand with the hatchet, causing the crooked sugar cakes to jump. "I want to ask you, was this cake steamed by your mother? Or was it made by your wife? Did you burn your hands when you steamed it? Did you burn your mouth when you ate it? It's as round as a ball. It doesn't even have any human touch. How dare you call it sweet?"
His roar was so real that many people in the audience blushed, thinking of the hands they burned when steaming the cakes at home and the smiles of the other people when passing the cakes. Those are the real things. But before Elder Mo could say anything, another fairy boy wearing silk pipes said sharply: "What do you know about elegance, a country boy? Can your crooked cake be put on the table? Can it catch the eyes of the God Emperor? My young master's Ruyi cake was presented to the princess for tasting yesterday, and the princess praised it with the word 'neat and neat'!"
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere changed instantly. Originally it was just a dispute between "elegant and vulgar", but now it involves the God-Emperor and the Princess, and "tasting" is also involved, and the flavor of comparison suddenly becomes overwhelming. Many descendants of Mortal Lineage looked at the "untouchable" objects in their hands, with shame and uneasiness on their faces, and some even wanted to throw the things away secretly.
Deep in the earth's veins, the black seed trembled violently. topHis eyes were opened to a slit, and his pupils reflected the appearances of all living beings on and off the stage - envy, shame, uneasiness, vanity... These "alienated thoughts" were like the finest nutrients, flowing into the black race's body along the earth's veins. Its roots were visibly thicker to the naked eye, and the reverse lines on the leaves were so shiny that they almost burst the earth veins.
Yun Qingyao watched all this with cold eyes. She saw a little fairy boy secretly stuffing her mother's embroidered, slightly threadless purse back into her arms, and staring enviously at the gold foil grass leaves in the jade plate; she saw the earthen jar of the fairy servant in the spiritual garden being laughed at as "vulgar" by several brocade fairy boys, and her old face turned red. She was blushing, but she didn't dare to refute; she even saw Lieyang God General clenching his fists, and the grass leaves on his palms were frighteningly hot, but due to the debate between "elegance and vulgarity", it was difficult to get angry - after all, the other party mentioned "in line with the way of heaven" and "the taste of the God Emperor".
"Neat and tidy?" Yun Qingyao finally spoke, her voice not loud, but like ice beads falling on a jade plate, it instantly suppressed all the noise. She walked to the crooked cake stall, picked up the piece of pieced sugar cake, and pointed at the plate of crooked sugar cakes that Ah Mao had just steamed and said, "Elder Mo, you said that this cake is crooked and does not comply with regulations. Then I ask you, what is 'regulation'? What is 'system'?"
Elder Mo folded his fan and said with a sneer: "The rules are the way of heaven. The Sweet Thoughts Festival is decreed by the God Emperor. Naturally, there must be rules and regulations in order to show the majesty of our divine realm and inherit the true meaning of forgetfulness."
"The true meaning of the Supreme Being's forgetfulness of love?" Yun Qingyao's lips curled up with a trace of faint sarcasm, "The Supreme Being's forgetfulness of love means forgetting 'private thoughts', not forgetting 'thoughts'. The Sweet Thoughts Festival commemorates the thoughts of ordinary people, it is the hot cake made by A Mao in memory of grandma, and the mint water made by the fairy servants in the spiritual garden remembering their mother. It’s a mouthful of wild fruit that Lieyang God has not forgotten for thirty thousand years. These thoughts include burning pain, missing corners, and crooked truths. These are ‘thoughts’! Your wishful cake is perfect, but has no pain, no regrets, and no thoughts. What does it have to do with the supreme forgetfulness?”
She changed the topic and pointed her fingertips at the jade table of the Yatian Club: "As for 'showing the majesty of the God Realm'? Is the majesty of the God Realm supported by a few pieces of ice-carved jade cakes? Or is it supported by the living sweetness in the hearts of thousands of mortal descendants?" She suddenly waved her sleeves, and the plate of golden Ruyi cake was lifted up by a soft force and flew over the sweet spring. "I will tell you today what the real 'sweetness' is!"
She didn't use her magical power to destroy it, she just flicked her finger, and a piece of sugar residue with tooth marks that fell from the Amao candy cake flew out and hit the Ruyi cake accurately.
"Pfft——"
There was no earth-shattering explosion. The moment the Ruyi Cake, regarded as an "elegant product," was touched by the mundane sugar dregs, it was like a popped soap bubble. Together with the jade plate below, it silently turned into powder, leaving not even a sliver of residue. There is only a faint, earthly sweet fragrance spreading over the spring.
The whole place was dead silent.
The fake smile on Elder Mo's face froze instantly, and the folding fan shattered with a "click". The brocade fairies behind him were even more expressionless and even forgot to breathe.
Chen Mo grinned, showing his white teeth: "It's great! I'm telling you, real gold is not afraid of fire, and real sweetness is not afraid of teeth! Your rotten cake can't even withstand a tooth mark!"
At this moment, a dull loud noise came from deep within the earth's veins, as if something had broken through the earth's crust. Immediately afterwards, the spring water in the center of the sweet spring suddenly exploded, and the black grass that had been lurking finally broke out of the ground! But it is no longer pure black, the leaves are entangled with gray-black evil energy, the eyes at the top have doubled in size, and the pupils are no longer void, but reflect the envy, shame, and comparison of everyone in the audience just now... Those "alienation thoughts" flow in its eyes and become the nutrients that nourish it.
"Jie Jie Jie..." A heart-wrenching smile came from the top of the black grass. It was no longer the roar before, but with a sticky, nauseating sweetness., "What a beautiful thought... envy, shame, comparison... much more delicious than pure resentment! Thank you for helping me feed myself!"
It laughed maniacally, and its roots plunged into the veins of the sweet spring. The originally clear and warm spring water instantly became thick and dim at a speed visible to the naked eye, and a layer of oily greasy surface appeared on the surface. It no longer exuded a sweet fragrance, but a suffocating, rottenly sweet smell.
Black people, no, it’s time to call them “sick devils”. Through the "alienation of thoughts", it finally broke out of the ground, and for the first time, it took the initiative to show itself to the world.
The figure of the God Emperor appeared on the cloud platform outside the Nine Dragons Palace. He looked at the changes in the sweet spring below, looked at the greasy demon, and looked at the mortal descendants who instantly fell into panic under the stage. For the first time, clear pain appeared in his chaotic eyes. He set up the Sweet Thoughts Festival, originally wanting to protect this little mortal spark, but he didn't expect that before this spark could set off a prairie fire, it would first be fattened by his own "regulation" and "comparison", fattening the lurking monster.
"Father..." Yun Qingyao looked up at Yuntai, with a subtle tremor in her voice. She knew that the real test had just begun. This greasy demon eats thoughts and vomits rot. It is far more difficult to deal with than the previous black grass.
Chen Mo pulled out the hatchet from the wooden stand. The crooked grass leaf pattern on the blade shone hot in the sweet air. He spat and grinned: "Damn, just come out! What's the point of hiding underground and eating secretly? Come out and I'll chop you up, you rotten-smelling dog! Let's see, which one is more powerful, your rotten sweetness or my crooked cake!"
The tired demon's pupils shrank, staring at the lines on Chen Mo's sword, then scanning the broken ruler at Yun Qingyao's fingertips, and finally landed on the descendants of the mortal lineage who were frightened but still clutching their crooked objects, and a silent and malicious smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
It's not rushed.
Now, it has tasted the most delicious part of "Nian".
Next, it has to watch how these "thoughts" compete with each other and rot themselves in its rottenness.
That's the feast.
